name: Automobile & PCB Inc.
summary: Automobile & PCB Inc., a South Korean enterprise, specializes in the production and distribution of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its extensive product line encompasses slim PCBs for applications like mobile phones, MP3 players, and TFT LCD screens; build-up PCBs tailored for cellular phones, DMB devices, and PCM cards; B.V.H PCBs designed for both portable and fixed electronic communication equipment; and multi-layer PCBs, which are essential components for switches, routers, electrical transmission communication systems, and various other communication and electronic goods. Furthermore, the company provides double-sided PCBs, frequently used in general electronics, communication products, and home appliances. Originally incorporated as Quality & Technology Korea Co., Ltd., the firm rebranded to Automobile & PCB Inc. in 2009. Founded in 1977, its corporate headquarters are located in Bucheon-si, South Korea.
